main_text.p: mus. Actum demum praeclarè nobiscū agitur, cum de humanis praesidiis desperantes, ad Deum confugimus, cum Dauid de orantes: Serua nos Deus, quia penetrârunt aquæ usque ad animam. Jam demersi sumus in lutum profundum, & ubi consistere non possumus. Psal.69.1.2.

Quomodo tota Ecclesia Domini Dei sui recordetur, ex hoc illius hymno discimus. Isa.63.7. Miserationes Iehouæ memoria repetam, & laudes Iehouæ pro omnibus quæ contulit nobis Iehouah, & multiplex bonum domui Israel, quod contulit eis secundum misericordiam suam, & secundum multitudinem miserationum suarum. Et Dauid: Ingrediar, ait, potentias Iehouæ, memor ero iustitiæ tuæ soli-us. Psal.71.16.

Per fidem autem Domini Dei sui recordantur fideles, cum sibi persuadent Custodem Israelis non dormitare neque dormire: esse custodē suum, & umbram dexterae: custodire quinetiam egressum & introitum nostrum. Psal.121.4.5.&8.

page.notes: Printed "Vt" for Ut and "Pfal" for Psal were kept as Vt/Psal per the i/j, u/v and long-s rules. "custodē" has a doubtful accent over the e; read as custodē[?]. "clarisimum" is a printing error left as printed. "potentias" was split at the line end after "potenti"; the completion is inferred from the next line's "as", and the scan gives no printed hyphen. The catchword "mea" is at the foot right; the paragraph ends on "quæ ta", as the text runs over to the next page.
